sources.text: It just turns up and it's good. I used to forget to buy beans until the jar was empty, now I never run out.
The Desk Blend is the best part of my workday. Smells amazing when you open the bag, and it tastes fresh for weeks.
My box arrived late twice this month. The coffee is lovely but I ended up drinking instant on a Wednesday again.
Ordered whole bean by mistake and don't own a grinder. Support switched me to ground in one email. Tastes fresh, no complaints.
The grind is too fine for my French press. I get sludge at the bottom of every cup. Please add a coarse option.
A bit pricey compared to supermarket coffee, but honestly worth every penny. Supermarket beans taste flat after a week.
The decaf doesn't taste like decaf. I can finally have an afternoon cup and still sleep.
We got the Team Box for our remote team of six. Everyone gets their own bags at home and the Monday call starts with coffee chat now.
Arrived late again. Third time. Great coffee, unreliable delivery. I shouldn't have to email every month.
Being able to pause my subscription before a trip is the reason I stayed. No pile of bags waiting when I get home.
Smells amazing when you open the bag. My whole flat smells like a café for an hour.
Too expensive for daily drinking if you have two cups a day. I switched to every two weeks and mix it with cheaper beans.
I work from home and this is my little ritual. First cup at my desk, before the laptop opens. It just turns up, I never think about it.
Decaf tasted a bit thin to me, like weak tea. The regular Desk Blend is great though.
Grind size was wrong for my espresso machine, way too coarse. Had to buy a grinder in the end.
The Single-Origin Rotation is like a little surprise every month. I've tried coffees I would never have picked myself.
Ordering for the team used to be a spreadsheet nightmare. The Team Box ships to each person, so nobody has to collect bags from the office.
Worth every penny. It's cheaper than the coffee shop on the corner and I don't have to put shoes on.
Delivery was late over the holidays and nobody told me. A heads-up email would have been nice.
Pausing is easy, it's one button on the account page. I pause my subscription every summer when we go away.
I never run out anymore. That alone was worth it. No more sad jar of instant at the back of the cupboard.
Fresh roasted coffee makes such a difference. You can taste the roast date. Supermarket coffee tastes flat next to it.
Wish there was a coarser grind for cold brew. The regular ground is too fine for my French press too.
The Swiss Water decaf is the first decaf that doesn't taste like decaf. My partner can't tell the difference.
Price went up and I nearly cancelled, but I went to every four weeks instead. Still the best coffee I can get delivered.
The box arrived late and the bag was fine, but I was already out. I'd rather it came a day early than a day late.
We use it as a perk for our remote team. People actually talk about it on Slack, which never happened with gift cards.
Smells amazing, tastes fresh, turns up on time. What more do you want from a coffee subscription.
Honestly I was sceptical about a coffee subscription, I thought I'd end up with a pile of bags. Skipping a delivery is easy though.
It's my afternoon cup now, the decaf. Doesn't taste like decaf at all, no cardboard aftertaste.
Great beans but it arrived late while I was on a work trip, and the parcel sat outside for two days.
The chocolate and hazelnut notes are real, not marketing talk. Best part of my workday, honestly.
A bit pricey, yes. But I throw away less coffee than when I bought big bags that went stale.
Ordering for the team is so much easier than expense reports for coffee. Our office manager loves it.
Grind size options are confusing. I didn't know which one my pour-over needed, and the guide is hidden.
I never run out and I never think about it. It just turns up and it's good, that's the whole review.
Coffee is great. Delivery is hit and miss, one box arrived late and one came early.
Tastes fresh even in week three. I used to think all coffee tasted the same, I was wrong.
Wanted to pause my subscription while I was moving house and it took two emails to find the button. Fine now.
Our remote team of twelve loves the Team Box. It's the one perk nobody forgets to use.
